messages:
Nora Blake: usability quick hit 1: users aren't spotting the copy control in the Console's Query modal. many try to drag-select instead of tapping the icon.
Ibrahim Khan: saw that too. on smaller viewports the icon sits flush with code gutters. Suggestion: increase hit area to 44x44 and add a subtle background hover so it's visually separate.
Lena Ortiz: microcopy: testers were split between 'Copy' and 'Copy query'. 'Copy' felt ambiguous to product folks. prefer 'Copy query' to be explicit.
Tom Brewer: implementation constraints: we shouldn't shift layout when enlarging the button. plan: absolutely-position the control inside the header and use transform for hover states. Also ensure z-index > modal content but < modal close.
Nora Blake: accessibility note: add aria-label="Copy query" and update an aria-live region after copy. Avoid exposing raw clipboard API strings to SRs.
accessibility-bot: a11y check: "Ensure focus styles meet contrast 3:1 and interactive elements have >= 44x44 tappable area."
Ibrahim Khan: example CSS to expand hit area without moving elements:
```
.copy-btn { position: relative; }
.copy-btn::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -8px; }
```
But watch stacking context so pseudo-element doesn't intercept pointer events.
Lena Ortiz: visual confirmation: testers missed global toasts. propose inline ephemeral chip: small 'Copied' pill that appears next to the control for 1.5s + check icon. Also update SR region: "Query copied".
Tom Brewer: keyboard flow: keep focus on the button post-copy. Do not shift focus to the pill. NVDA reads aria-live changes; set aria-live="polite".
Nora Blake: microcopy decision: 'Copy query' it is. I'll produce three quick frames: (A) icon-only larger tap target + tooltip, (B) icon + inline pill on success, (C) icon+label at <480px. Posting in #design in ~20m.
Ibrahim Khan: dev note: will prototype the aria-live implementation and keyboard behavior in a tiny PR. I'll include tests for focus retention and screen reader text update.
Lena Ortiz: a11y nit: don't rely on color alone for success state. use check icon + text and ensure contrast of the pill meets AA.
accessibility-bot: follow-up: "Add role and keyboard handlers only if element is non-button. If using <button>, avoid role=\"button\"."
Tom Brewer: pinging infra: ensure modal clipping/z-index doesn't hide pill on small heights. If modal scrolls, fallback to a global toast.
Nora Blake: thanks all. tagging @Ibrahim for PR and @Lena for final a11y signoff. leaving thread open until mocks + PR are linked. :thumbsup:
